.github/workflows/audio-cancellation-bou.content:
name: Audio cancellation boundary JS checks
on:
  push:
    branches: [codex/audio-cancellation-boundary]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  javascript:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020
        with:
          node-version: 22.13.1
          cache: npm
      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Audio cancellation behavioral regressions
        run: npx tsx --test tests/timeline-audio-cancellation-boundary.test.mjs
      - name: Full JavaScript and TypeScript behavioral suite
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: npm run test:logic
      - name: Product contract
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: npm run verify:product-contract
      - name: TypeScript
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: npx tsc --noEmit
      - name: Lint
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: npm run lint
      - name: Cancellation caller impact inventory
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: |
          if command -v rg >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            rg -n 'createTimelineTranscriptionSession|generateProjectCaptions|generateAndSaveProjectCaptions|cancelProjectCaptionGeneration|cancelAudioExtraction|renderTimelineAudio|TimelineAudioRenderer\.(render|cancel)|finishCancelledTimelineAudioRender' src modules/caption-media/src modules/caption-media/android/src/main
          else
            grep -RnE 'createTimelineTranscriptionSession|generateProjectCaptions|generateAndSaveProjectCaptions|cancelProjectCaptionGeneration|cancelAudioExtraction|renderTimelineAudio|TimelineAudioRenderer\.(render|cancel)|finishCancelledTimelineAudioRender' src modules/caption-media/src modules/caption-media/android/src/main
          fi

.github/workflows/ci.yml.content:
name: Android commercial release gate

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main, codex/source-echo-protected-composition]
    tags: ["v*"]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: android-release-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  CI: true
  CAPTION_STUDIO_EXPECTED_ANDROID_PACKAGE: com.xmilo_at_your_side.caption_studio

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 75
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 22.13.1
          cache: npm
      - uses: actions/setup-java@dd06d9cba3e5552c54d9f8ea23572deb30010f7c # v6.0.0
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17
          cache: gradle

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Audit production dependencies
        run: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
      - name: Test JavaScript and TypeScript contracts
        run: |
          npm run verify:product-contract
          npm run test:logic
          npx tsc --noEmit
          npm run lint
      - name: Verify Expo SDK compatibility
        run: |
          npx expo install --check
          npx --yes expo-doctor@1.20.4

      - name: Generate a clean Android project
        env:
          NODE_ENV: production
        run: |
          npx expo prebuild --platform android --clean --no-install
          node ./scripts/patch-react-native-gradle.js
          npm run verify:android-config
      - name: Configure ephemeral CI release signing
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          keystore="$RUNNER_TEMP/caption-studio-ci-release.p12"
          password="caption-studio-ci-only"
          keytool -genkeypair -noprompt \
            -storetype PKCS12 \
            -keystore "$keystore" \
            -storepass "$password" \
            -keypass "$password" \
            -alias caption-studio-ci \
            -keyalg RSA \
            -keysize 3072 \
            -sigalg SHA256withRSA \
            -validity 2 \
            -dname "CN=Caption Studio CI,OU=Release Verification,O=Hatsunama,C=US"
          chmod 600 "$keystore"
          mkdir -p "$HOME/.gradle"
          chmod 700 "$HOME/.gradle"
          {
            echo "CAPTION_STUDIO_RELEASE_STORE_FILE=$keystore"
            echo "CAPTION_STUDIO_RELEASE_STORE_PASSWORD=$password"
            echo "CAPTION_STUDIO_RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS=caption-studio-ci"
            echo "CAPTION_STUDIO_RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD=$password"
          } >> "$HOME/.gradle/gradle.properties"
          chmod 600 "$HOME/.gradle/gradle.properties"

      - name: Lint Android release code
        env:
          NODE_ENV: production
        working-directory: android
        run: ./gradlew :app:lintRelease --init-script ../scripts/first-party-android-lint.gradle --no-daemon --stacktrace --warning-mode all

      - name: Test Caption Studio Android release modules
        env:
          NODE_ENV: production
        working-directory: android
        run: ./gradlew :app:testReleaseUnitTest :caption-diagnostics:testReleaseUnitTest :caption-media:testReleaseUnitTest :caption-translation:testReleaseUnitTest --no-daemon --stacktrace --warning-mode all

      - name: Build release artifacts
        env:
          NODE_ENV: production
        working-directory: android
        run: ./gradlew :app:assembleRelease :app:bundleRelease --no-daemon --stacktrace --warning-mode all

      - name: Verify release identity, signing, alignment, and target SDK
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          apk="android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk"
          aab="android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab"
          test -s "$apk"
          test -s "$aab"
          node ./scripts/verify-android-abi.mjs --apk "$apk" --aab "$aab"
          build_tools="$(find "$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | sort -V | tail -n 1)"
          test -x "$build_tools/aapt"
          test -x "$build_tools/apksigner"
          test -x "$build_tools/zipalign"
          ndk_root="$(find "$ANDROID_HOME/ndk" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | sort -V | tail -n 1)"
          llvm_objdump="$ndk_root/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/llvm-objdump"
          test -x "$llvm_objdump"
          badging="$($build_tools/aapt dump badging "$apk")"
          printf '%s\n' "$badging"
          expected_package="$CAPTION_STUDIO_EXPECTED_ANDROID_PACKAGE"
          test "$(node -p "require('./app.json').expo.android.package")" = "$expected_package"
          expected_version_code="$(node -p "require('./app.json').expo.android.versionCode")"
          expected_version_name="$(node -p "require('./app.json').expo.version")"
          grep -Fq "package: name='$expected_package' versionCode='$expected_version_code' versionName='$expected_version_name'" <<< "$badging"
          grep -Fq "targetSdkVersion:'36'" <<< "$badging"
          "$build_tools/zipalign" -c -P 16 4 "$apk"
          bash ./scripts/check-elf-16k-alignment.sh "$apk" "$llvm_objdump"
          certificate="$($build_tools/apksigner verify --verbose --print-certs "$apk")"
          printf '%s\n' "$certificate"
          grep -Fq "CN=Caption Studio CI" <<< "$certificate"
          if grep -Eqi "Android Debug|androiddebugkey" <<< "$certificate"; then
            echo "Release APK was signed with the Android debug identity" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          jarsigner -verify "$aab"
          bundle_certificate="$(keytool -printcert -jarfile "$aab")"
          printf '%s\n' "$bundle_certificate"
          grep -Fq "CN=Caption Studio CI" <<< "$bundle_certificate"
          if grep -Eqi "Android Debug|androiddebugkey" <<< "$bundle_certificate"; then
            echo "Release bundle was signed with the Android debug identity" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Retain native unit-test reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: native-release-test-reports-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            android/app/build/reports/tests/testReleaseUnitTest/
            android/app/build/test-results/testReleaseUnitTest/
            modules/caption-diagnostics/android/build/reports/tests/testReleaseUnitTest/
            modules/caption-diagnostics/android/build/test-results/testReleaseUnitTest/
            modules/caption-media/android/build/reports/tests/testReleaseUnitTest/
            modules/caption-media/android/build/test-results/testReleaseUnitTest/
            modules/caption-translation/android/build/reports/tests/testReleaseUnitTest/
            modules/caption-translation/android/build/test-results/testReleaseUnitTest/
            android/build/reports/problems/problems-report.html
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Retain CI-signed release-validation APK and AAB
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: caption-studio-ci-validation-only-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk
            android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

.github/workflows/native-audio-lanes.yml.content:
name: Native timeline audio lanes

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [codex/timeline-audio-bounded-lanes, codex/preservation-runtime-contract, codex/audio-cancellation-boundary]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  native-audio:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020
        with:
          node-version: 22.13.1
          cache: npm
      - uses: actions/setup-java@dd06d9cba3e5552c54d9f8ea23572deb30010f7c
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17
          cache: gradle
      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          mkdir -p evidence
          npm ci 2>&1 | tee evidence/npm-ci.log
      - name: Generate cloud Android project
        env:
          NODE_ENV: production
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          npx expo prebuild --platform android --clean --no-install 2>&1 | tee evidence/prebuild.log
          node scripts/patch-react-native-gradle.js
      - name: Execute production composition regression
        env:
          NODE_ENV: production
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          cd android
          ./gradlew :caption-media:testReleaseUnitTest --no-daemon --stacktrace --console=plain 2>&1 | tee ../evidence/native-audio.log
      - name: Retain complete raw evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: native-audio-raw-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            evidence/
            modules/caption-media/android/build/test-results/
            modules/caption-media/android/build/reports/tests/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90

.github/workflows/pages.yml.content:
name: Publish privacy policy

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - docs/privacy/**
      - .github/workflows/pages.yml
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@45bfe0192ca1faeb007ade9deae92b16b8254a0d # v6.0.0
      - name: Stage public privacy site
        shell: bash
        run: |
          mkdir -p _site/privacy
          cp -R docs/privacy/. _site/privacy/
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@fc324d3547104276b827a68afc52ff2a11cc49c9 # v5.0.0
        with:
          path: _site
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@cd2ce8fcbc39b97be8ca5fce6e763baed58fa128 # v5.0.0

.github/workflows/private-artifact-gate-.content:
name: Private artifact gate behavioral test

on:
  push:
    branches: [codex/private-artifact-gate, codex/preservation-runtime-contract]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/publish-sidecar.yml
      - .github/workflows/private-artifact-gate-test.yml
      - scripts/test-private-artifact-gate.mjs

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  gate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        state: [success, failure, cancelled, recovery]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
          sparse-checkout: |
            .github/workflows
            scripts/test-private-artifact-gate.mjs
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 22.13.1
      - name: Execute actual release expressions and guard
        env:
          GATE_STATE: ${{ matrix.state }}
          GATE_WORKSPACE: ${{ github.workspace }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          harness="$RUNNER_TEMP/private-artifact-gate"
          mkdir -p "$harness"
          npm install --prefix "$harness" --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --package-lock=false @actions/expressions@0.3.61 yaml@2.8.1
          cp scripts/test-private-artifact-gate.mjs "$harness/test.mjs"
          node "$harness/test.mjs"

.github/workflows/publish-sidecar.yml.content:
name: Publish Caption Studio Android release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: Semantic version written into the APK
        required: true
        type: string
      version_code:
        description: Monotonically increasing Android versionCode
        required: true
        type: string
      publish:
        description: Publish the tagged release; false retains a signed private test artifact only
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: caption-studio-release
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  release:
    # toJSON distinguishes Boolean false from missing, null, zero, and strings.
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' ||
       (github.ref == 'refs/heads/codex/preservation-runtime-contract' &&
        toJSON(inputs.publish) == 'false'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - name: Enforce dispatch trust boundary
        shell: bash
        env:
          PUBLISH_JSON: ${{ toJSON(inputs.publish) }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Expressions compare strings without case sensitivity. Enforce exact
          # refs before checkout, repository code, or signing credentials.
          [[ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" == "workflow_dispatch" ]]
          case "$GITHUB_REF" in
            refs/heads/main) ;;
            refs/heads/codex/preservation-runtime-contract)
              [[ "$PUBLISH_JSON" == "false" ]]
              ;;
            *)
              echo "Ref is not authorized for sidecar dispatch." >&2
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 22.13.1
          cache: npm
      - uses: actions/setup-java@dd06d9cba3e5552c54d9f8ea23572deb30010f7c # v6.0.0
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17
          cache: gradle

      - name: Load product contract
        run: |
          node ./scripts/generate-product-contract.mjs --check --github-env
          node -e "const c = require('./config/product-contract.json'); const id = 'com.xmilo_at_your_side.caption_studio'; if (c.android.sourcePackage !== id || c.android.release.package !== id) throw new Error('Unexpected Android application id');"
          # Historical immutable releases require reading the actual APK metadata.
          build_tools="$(find "$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | sort -V | tail -n 1)"
          test -x "$build_tools/aapt"
          test -x "$build_tools/apksigner"
          echo "SIDECAR_BUILD_TOOLS=$build_tools" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Validate release inputs
        shell: bash
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          VERSION_CODE: ${{ inputs.version_code }}
          PUBLISH: ${{ inputs.publish }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]
          [[ "$VERSION_CODE" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]
          node ./scripts/configure-sidecar-release.mjs --check-published "$VERSION" "$VERSION_CODE"
          if [[ "$PUBLISH" == "true" ]]; then
            tag="v${VERSION}"
            if gh release view "$tag" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Release $tag already exists; refusing replacement." >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            if ! git ls-remote --exit-code --tags origin "refs/tags/$tag" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Protected release tag $tag must exist before dispatch." >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "refs/tags/$tag:refs/tags/$tag"
            tag_commit="$(git rev-parse "$tag^{commit}")"
            if [[ "$tag_commit" != "$GITHUB_SHA" ]]; then
              echo "Protected release tag $tag points to $tag_commit, expected $GITHUB_SHA." >&2
              exit 1
            fi
          fi
      - name: Install and verify locked project
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run verify:product-contract
          npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
          npm run test:logic
          npx tsc --noEmit
          npm run lint
          npx expo install --check
          npx --yes expo-doctor@1.20.4

      - name: Configure expected Android application identity
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          VERSION_CODE: ${{ inputs.version_code }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node ./scripts/configure-sidecar-release.mjs "$VERSION" "$VERSION_CODE"

      - name: Generate clean Android project
        env:
          NODE_ENV: production
          CAPTION_STUDIO_EXPECTED_ANDROID_PACKAGE: ${{ env.CAPTION_STUDIO_RELEASE_PACKAGE }}
        run: |
          npx expo prebuild --platform android --clean --no-install
          node ./scripts/patch-react-native-gradle.js
          npm run verify:android-config

      - name: Configure stable release signing
        shell: bash
        env:
          KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.CAPTION_STUDIO_FIXED_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          STORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.CAPTION_STUDIO_FIXED_STORE_PASSWORD }}
          KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.CAPTION_STUDIO_FIXED_KEY_ALIAS }}
          KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.CAPTION_STUDIO_FIXED_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -n "$KEYSTORE_BASE64"
          test -n "$STORE_PASSWORD"
          test -n "$KEY_ALIAS"
          test -n "$KEY_PASSWORD"
          keystore="$RUNNER_TEMP/caption-studio-release.p12"
          printf '%s' "$KEYSTORE_BASE64" | base64 --decode > "$keystore"
          chmod 600 "$keystore"
          mkdir -p "$HOME/.gradle"
          chmod 700 "$HOME/.gradle"
          {
            echo "CAPTION_STUDIO_RELEASE_STORE_FILE=$keystore"
            echo "CAPTION_STUDIO_RELEASE_STORE_PASSWORD=$STORE_PASSWORD"
            echo "CAPTION_STUDIO_RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS=$KEY_ALIAS"
            echo "CAPTION_STUDIO_RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD=$KEY_PASSWORD"
          } >> "$HOME/.gradle/gradle.properties"
          chmod 600 "$HOME/.gradle/gradle.properties"

      - name: Lint Android release code
        env:
          NODE_ENV: production
        working-directory: android
        run: ./gradlew :app:lintRelease --init-script ../scripts/first-party-android-lint.gradle --no-daemon --stacktrace --warning-mode all

      - name: Test Caption Studio Android release modules
        env:
          NODE_ENV: production
        working-directory: android
        run: ./gradlew :app:testReleaseUnitTest :caption-diagnostics:testReleaseUnitTest :caption-media:testReleaseUnitTest :caption-translation:testReleaseUnitTest --no-daemon --stacktrace --warning-mode all

      - name: Build Caption Studio release APK
        env:
          NODE_ENV: production
        working-directory: android
        run: ./gradlew :app:assembleRelease --no-daemon --stacktrace --warning-mode all

      - name: Verify and package APK
        id: package
        shell: bash
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          VERSION_CODE: ${{ inputs.version_code }}
          PUBLISH: ${{ inputs.publish }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          source_apk="android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk"
          test -s "$source_apk"
          node ./scripts/verify-android-abi.mjs --apk "$source_apk"
          build_tools="$(find "$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | sort -V | tail -n 1)"
          ndk_root="$(find "$ANDROID_HOME/ndk" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | sort -V | tail -n 1)"
          badging="$($build_tools/aapt dump badging "$source_apk")"
          printf '%s\n' "$badging"
          grep -Fq "package: name='$CAPTION_STUDIO_RELEASE_PACKAGE' versionCode='$VERSION_CODE' versionName='$VERSION'" <<< "$badging"
          grep -Fq "targetSdkVersion:'36'" <<< "$badging"
          "$build_tools/zipalign" -c -P 16 4 "$source_apk"
          bash ./scripts/check-elf-16k-alignment.sh "$source_apk" "$ndk_root/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/llvm-objdump"
          certificate="$($build_tools/apksigner verify --verbose --print-certs "$source_apk")"
          printf '%s\n' "$certificate"
          # This contract pin detects signing mistakes; a mutable same-repo pin
          # is not an independent trust anchor against repository compromise.
          actual_certificate="$(sed -nE 's/^.*certificate SHA-256 digest: ([0-9a-fA-F]+).*$/\1/p' <<< "$certificate" | head -n 1 | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          test "$actual_certificate" = "$CAPTION_STUDIO_RELEASE_CERT_SHA256"
          if grep -Eqi "Android Debug|androiddebugkey|Caption Studio CI" <<< "$certificate"; then
            echo 'APK has an invalid signing identity.' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          mkdir -p dist
          cp "$source_apk" "dist/$CAPTION_STUDIO_RELEASE_ASSET"
          (cd dist && sha256sum "$CAPTION_STUDIO_RELEASE_ASSET" > "$CAPTION_STUDIO_RELEASE_ASSET.sha256")
          if [[ "$PUBLISH" == "true" ]]; then
            node ./scripts/configure-sidecar-release.mjs --write-metadata \
              "$VERSION" "$VERSION_CODE" "dist/$CAPTION_STUDIO_RELEASE_ASSET" \
              dist/caption-studio-release.json
          fi

      - name: Publish prerelease without replacement
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && toJSON(inputs.publish) == 'true'
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          VERSION_CODE: ${{ inputs.version_code }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tag="v${VERSION}"
          # Recheck after building. Concurrency serializes this workflow only;
          # repository rules must restrict other release writers separately.
          node ./scripts/configure-sidecar-release.mjs --check-published "$VERSION" "$VERSION_CODE"
          gh release create "$tag" \
            "dist/$CAPTION_STUDIO_RELEASE_ASSET" \
            "dist/$CAPTION_STUDIO_RELEASE_ASSET.sha256" \
            dist/caption-studio-release.json \
            --prerelease \
            --title "Caption Studio ${VERSION}" \
            --notes "Android build from main at $GITHUB_SHA for package $CAPTION_STUDIO_RELEASE_PACKAGE. First installation uses a separate sandbox from older Caption Studio package IDs; their apps and projects remain untouched and are not migrated. Only an existing installation of this same package with compatible signing can be updated in place. No app is uninstalled or cleared."

      - name: Retain Caption Studio APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: caption-studio-${{ inputs.version }}
          path: dist/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

name: Translation preservation repair checks
on:

permissions:
  contents: read
env:
  CI: true
jobs:
  acceptance:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020
        with:
          node-version: 22.13.1
      - uses: actions/setup-java@dd06d9cba3e5552c54d9f8ea23572deb30010f7c
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17
      - name: Install locked test dependencies
        run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Verify published dependency regressions and consumer compatibility
        run: |
          node --test tests/published-dependency-regressions.cjs

      - name: Run full suites, preservation regressions, and repository gates

          name: translation-preservation-repair

          retention-days: 14

.github/workflows/verify-play-aab.yml.content:
name: Verify production-signed Google Play AAB

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: Existing published Caption Studio release tag (for example v1.4.105)
        required: true
        type: string
      version_code:
        description: Exact versionCode recorded in that release's manifest
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: caption-studio-play-aab
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  verify:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.repository == 'Hatsunama/Caption-Studio'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    env:
      CI: true
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out approved release source separately
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.tag }}
          path: release-source
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 22.13.1
          cache: npm
      - uses: actions/setup-java@dd06d9cba3e5552c54d9f8ea23572deb30010f7c # v6.0.0
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17
          cache: gradle

      - name: Install and verify locked project
        working-directory: release-source
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run verify:product-contract
          npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
          npm run test:logic
          npx tsc --noEmit
          npm run lint
          npx expo install --check
          npx --yes expo-doctor@1.20.4

      - name: Verify published release approval and configure source checkout
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          TAG: ${{ inputs.tag }}
          VERSION_CODE: ${{ inputs.version_code }}
        run: node ./scripts/verify-play-aab.mjs --prepare "$TAG" "$VERSION_CODE" release-source

      - name: Generate clean Android project
        working-directory: release-source
        env:
          NODE_ENV: production
          CAPTION_STUDIO_EXPECTED_ANDROID_PACKAGE: com.xmilo_at_your_side.caption_studio
        run: |
          npx expo prebuild --platform android --clean --no-install
          node ./scripts/patch-react-native-gradle.js
          npm run verify:android-config

      - name: Require production signing credentials
        shell: bash
        env:
          KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.CAPTION_STUDIO_FIXED_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          STORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.CAPTION_STUDIO_FIXED_STORE_PASSWORD }}
          KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.CAPTION_STUDIO_FIXED_KEY_ALIAS }}
          KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.CAPTION_STUDIO_FIXED_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for name in KEYSTORE_BASE64 STORE_PASSWORD KEY_ALIAS KEY_PASSWORD; do
            if [[ -z "${!name}" ]]; then
              echo "Missing production signing credential: $name" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          keystore="$RUNNER_TEMP/caption-studio-play-upload.p12"
          printf '%s' "$KEYSTORE_BASE64" | base64 --decode > "$keystore"
          test -s "$keystore"
          chmod 600 "$keystore"
          echo "ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_CAPTION_STUDIO_RELEASE_STORE_FILE=$keystore" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Lint and test native release modules
        working-directory: release-source/android
        env:
          NODE_ENV: production
          ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_CAPTION_STUDIO_RELEASE_STORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.CAPTION_STUDIO_FIXED_STORE_PASSWORD }}
          ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_CAPTION_STUDIO_RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.CAPTION_STUDIO_FIXED_KEY_ALIAS }}
          ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_CAPTION_STUDIO_RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.CAPTION_STUDIO_FIXED_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          ./gradlew :app:lintRelease --init-script ../scripts/first-party-android-lint.gradle --no-daemon --stacktrace --warning-mode all
          ./gradlew :app:testReleaseUnitTest :caption-diagnostics:testReleaseUnitTest :caption-media:testReleaseUnitTest :caption-translation:testReleaseUnitTest --no-daemon --stacktrace --warning-mode all

      - name: Build production-signed Play bundle
        working-directory: release-source/android
        env:
          NODE_ENV: production
          ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_CAPTION_STUDIO_RELEASE_STORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.CAPTION_STUDIO_FIXED_STORE_PASSWORD }}
          ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_CAPTION_STUDIO_RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.CAPTION_STUDIO_FIXED_KEY_ALIAS }}
          ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_CAPTION_STUDIO_RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.CAPTION_STUDIO_FIXED_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: ./gradlew :app:bundleRelease --no-daemon --stacktrace --warning-mode all

      - name: Download pinned bundletool
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl --fail --location --silent --show-error \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/bundletool.jar" \
            https://github.com/google/bundletool/releases/download/1.18.3/bundletool-all-1.18.3.jar
          echo 'a099cfa1543f55593bc2ed16a70a7c67fe54b1747bb7301f37fdfd6d91028e29  '"$RUNNER_TEMP/bundletool.jar" | sha256sum --check --status
          echo "CAPTION_STUDIO_BUNDLETOOL=$RUNNER_TEMP/bundletool.jar" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Verify bundle identity, signature, and provenance
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          node ./scripts/verify-android-abi.mjs --aab release-source/android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab
          node ./scripts/verify-play-aab.mjs --verify \
            release-source dist/play-aab-approval.json "$CAPTION_STUDIO_BUNDLETOOL"

      - name: Retain verified Play bundle and provenance as Actions artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: caption-studio-play-aab-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            dist/caption-studio-play.aab
            dist/caption-studio-play-mapping.txt
            dist/play-aab-provenance.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
